title: AI能压降：医疗成本？，信诺高管给出肯定答案
speaker: Jason Salar

segments.en: Is there something Jason that can be done to sort of fix this? I mean, how do we mitigate the rising cost of policies?
segments.zh: Jason，有什么办法可以解决这个问题吗？我们如何缓解保单成本的上升？

segments.en: Yeah, so affordability is absolutely our number one priority. We want to be able to ensure that people can have access to affordable health care no matter where they are in the world.
segments.zh: 可负担性绝对是我们的首要任务。我们希望确保世界各地的人们都能获得负担得起的医疗服务。

segments.en: And part of it starts with prevention, because prevention is always better than cure.
segments.zh: 部分解决方案始于预防，因为预防总是胜于治疗。

segments.en: So encouraging people to go for regular health checkups, lead a healthy lifestyle, when they do identify that they have a health issue, us helping them navigate what often in many markets can be quite a complex environment to sort of operate in.
segments.zh: 我们鼓励人们定期体检、保持健康生活方式。当他们发现健康问题时，我们帮助他们应对许多市场中复杂的就医环境。

segments.en: And we continue to part with them throughout their health journey. Talk to us as well about then, you know, your reason, interesting point in terms of affordability, whether AI, you think can play a role in bringing down costs, I mean, in terms of savings, in terms of flagging, chronic illnesses earlier, for example.
segments.zh: 我们会在他们的整个健康旅程中陪伴他们。再谈谈您关于可负担性的有趣观点，您认为AI能否在降低成本方面发挥作用，比如节省开支、更早发现慢性病等。

segments.en: Absolutely. I mean, Signal is embracing AI at every part of the organization.
segments.zh: 当然。信诺正在整个组织中拥抱AI。

segments.en: We see it provides a great opportunity to help customers navigate what is often a complex environment, enables us to personalize solutions to them, to their needs, deliver them more effectively,
segments.zh: 我们认为AI提供了巨大机会，帮助客户应对复杂环境，使我们能够根据他们的需求提供个性化解决方案，并更有效地交付。

segments.en: which in turn helps address some of that affordability issues that we were just talking about as well.
segments.zh: 这反过来也有助于解决我们刚才讨论的一些可负担性问题。
